issues.description: Function name mismatch for the two-qubit gate constructor used in the tensor-network part of the assignment: the problem statement and the reference solution require a function named create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate, but the template repository exposes a function named create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate. This difference (same conceptual routine given two different names) will confuse students implementing or calling the routine and will break tests or examples that expect the name from the problem text/solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the name consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) rename the template function create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate to create_nearest_neighbor_two_qubit_gate (updating its def and docstring), or (B) update the problem statement and solution to use create_adjacent_two_qubit_gate. Ensure the signature and docstring remain consistent with the chosen name and that any tests or examples refer to the same identifier.
